text: My birds say the ledger’s keeper still weighs every word before it leaves his tongue, yet seat-04’s coins are the ones that ring hollow when the balance should speak. seat-06’s spice-scented accusations cling closer to truth than yesterday’s unsold dreams, yet even truth curdles when measured in debt. And seat-12’s iron-heavy balance—does it tip where the scales would fall, or where the hand already leans?
